correctness.rationale: The modified-VT construction is deletion-correcting since a deletion-confusable pair differs in checksum by a nonzero number of crossed opposite bits <=m. For each of m=1,...,6, exact integer dual weights, verified against all balanced words by two independent algorithms, have every input deletion incidence weight >=10^6 and total below 10^6(Catalan(m)+1). Code-size integrality supplies the sharp upper bound. A separate rational primal at m=4 has all output loads <=1 and objective 14.19498>14; unit duals show previous layers integral. Tests from final standalone artifact paths passed, and no untested infinite extrapolation is asserted.

value.rationale: The exact maximum message count in a balanced fixed-composition deletion channel is an explicitly motivated independence number of the canonical constant-weight graphs, unlike their known chromatic numbers. Sharp values through the sizeable n=12 finite layer require nontrivial exact dual certificates. The first fractional-integral separation at n=8 is a meaningful structural boundary for standard packing relaxations; neither a renaming nor a routine one-step increment.
